BiblicalUsage: Parshegen is a copy, a transcript, a letter set out in writing. Ezra 4:11 gives the copy of the letter the adversaries sent to Artaxerxes, and Ezra 5:6 gives the copy of the letter Tattenai and his companions sent to Darius.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the copies of the letters matter because the opposition was written down and answered in writing, and God worked through the paperwork as surely as through the prophets.
